Hey there! I’m Sany Kim, a 22-year-old female on a working holiday visa with 12 months left in Australia.
I really like your place and was wondering if I could come and inspect the room. I’m very clean and organized, and I’ve lived in studio/rental apartments for 3 years, so I know how to take good care of a place.
I don’t smoke and I have a friendly, sociable personality, so I enjoy chatting and getting along well with housemates while still respecting their space.
In my free time, I love exploring new food spots, swimming, and taking photos. I’d ideally like to move in before the 21st of March if possible.
